tick.prompt: Single soft glassy UI tick, tiny high-quality interface click, dry, subtle

whoosh_in.prompt: Soft airy cinematic whoosh, smooth and clean, medium-fast pass from left to right, no impact, subtle, high quality motion graphics transition

whoosh_out.prompt: Very short soft reverse whoosh, gentle air suck-back, clean and subtle, motion graphics transition out

swell.prompt: Deep smooth cinematic sub swell with soft airy shimmer rising then settling, elegant, for a 3D camera move in a tech explainer, no impact

light.prompt: Soft warm shimmer chime as a button lights up, gentle glass sparkle, short, elegant, subtle

pop.prompt: Single soft rounded bubble pop for a UI chip appearing, muted, pleasant, dry, very short

count.prompt: Fast soft digital counter ticking upward in pitch, light rapid clicks rising for one second then one soft landing click

type.prompt: Soft mechanical keyboard typing a short sentence, quiet, close, dry, natural rhythm

draw.prompt: Smooth soft synth glide rising gently like a line being drawn on a chart, airy, clean, subtle

strike.prompt: Quick pen strike-through swipe with a soft low thud at the end, dry, short

wrong.prompt: Soft low muted error tone, two gentle descending notes, not harsh, short, modern interface

right.prompt: Gentle bright confirmation chime, two soft ascending notes, clean modern interface, short

impact.prompt: Deep soft cinematic boom with a short tail, round sub hit, not aggressive, for a big number landing on screen

riser.prompt: Smooth airy riser building tension for two seconds, clean, no impact at the end, modern trailer style but subtle

slide.prompt: Short soft swish of a card sliding in, light paper-like air movement, dry, subtle

scan.prompt: Soft electronic scanner sweep, gentle rising hum passing by, clean sci-fi interface, subtle
